annotations.title: What a North Carolina (NC) statute cites, what cites it, and its rules

description:
Which North Carolina (NC) statutes this section cites, which cite it, and which agency
rules implement it.

Use for "what does G.S. 14-72.1 depend on", "what else references it", or "what rules
were adopted under G.S. 150B-21.2". OUTBOUND is what the section's own text cites;
INBOUND is every section citing it — the direction you cannot get by reading one statute
— plus `implementing_rules`: NC Administrative Code rules that cite it as their
authority.

Section-level only: a reference to 20-141(j1) is an edge to 20-141. Chapter-wide and
"this Article" references are not edges. For the text itself use get_statute.

citation.description: The section whose references you want, in either direction.
